versions.content: The DTC-specific Flash Amber Warning Lamp shall be set to Fast Flash (0x01) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the De- mIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemAmberWarningIndicator- Ref is set to DEM_INDICATOR_FAST_FLASH .

The DTC-specific Flash Amber Warning Lamp shall be set to Fast Flash (0x01) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the De- mIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemAmberWarningIndicator- Ref is set to DEM_INDICATOR_FAST_FLASH .

The DTC-specific Flash Amber Warning Lamp shall be set to Fast Flash (0x01) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the De- mIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemAmberWarningIndicator- Ref is set to DEM_INDICATOR_FAST_FLASH .
